chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), from Ibn Faddal, from Abu Jamilyah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali, Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), was brought a man who masturbated until he ejaculated, so he struck his hand with a rod until it turned red.
And I do not know except that he said: 'Marry him from the treasury of the Muslims.'

key_terms.بِالدَّرَّةِ: with a rod or small stick
key_terms.زَوَّجُوهُ: marry him (provide bride price/dowry from treasury)
key_terms.عَبَثَ: to masturbate or play with oneself

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for masturbation in Shia jurisprudence according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the principle of *ta'zir* (discretionary punishment) by Imam Ali (AS), prescribing the striking of the hand until it reddens for masturbation leading to ejaculation, alongside the unique practice of marrying the offender from the public treasury (*bayt al-mal*). The third narration clarifies that if ejaculation did not occur, there is no fixed penalty, highlighting the Imam's authority to adapt the punishment based on the specific circumstances and degree of the act.
